authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL nakha subsection 2 nakkha explicitly gives Bshk nakh, Savi nakē and Torwali nōkh. Selected Bshk naī̃k/nūk/nāk and Mai nākh forms follow that regional branch; Oriya no.kʰo and Vasavi nakhõ are provisionally grouped with the retained velar-aspirate family. Source nasalization, vowels, h loss or retention and punctuation remain intact; local transmission and the historical geminate are qualified. The complete repeated-form slash response is preserved. Longer -ḍo/-ḍio nail forms remain separate. Exact response: no.kʰo.

proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL hṛdaya heart explicitly gives Gawri hiṛa, Kalasha hīṛa/hṛiya, Phalura hiṛo, Torwali huī, Lahnda hā̃, eastern hiyā and western hiya/hīyo. The selected reduced heart forms fit these regional comparisons, preserving vowels, rhotic loss, h loss, nasalization and final glide/inflection. The conservative hraday/hīrday/hrɛday-type forms are included with learned or cross-IA transmission unresolved; source spacing and phonetics remain unchanged. The heart sense is directly documented and not inferred from unrelated kidney or lung terms. Exact response: həṛudaio.
